service.name: dns
service.description: Rig resolver stack (per dns VM): redis + coredns + dns-bridge.
service._comment_assets: dns-seed = the bootstrap zone artifact, deployment-plane: resolves as ${REGISTRY}/${CS_DEPLOY_NS}/zone-<CS_DOMAIN>-seed:<release> (all from the bootstrap — same resolution at deploy and at CI/CD package time). compose-up (dev) skips asset staging by design — vm-stack fills the volume from seed/; Step 2's attested run pulls the artifact. Volume stays keep until that run refills it (recreate would wipe the dev fill).
